item.alexscaves_nuclear_convergence.autu: Applies 20 seconds of Irradiated I on hit
alexscaves_nuclear_convergence.ponder.nu: Start with a 2×2 layer of 4 Nuclear Furnace Components
Once all 8 parts are in place, the furnace assembles itself
A nuclear furnace takes its inputs and outputs on different faces
Uranium or thorium rods go in from the right side as fuel
Raw materials go in from the back and are smelted inside
Metal barrels go in from the left to collect the waste and keep the furnace from going critical
Waste barrels and smelted products come out from the bottom
A nuclear furnace can safely store 9 units of waste; exceeding that triggers a nuclear explosion
4 units of waste: the bottom of the furnace starts glowing red
6 units of waste: the furnace goes out of control, fires break out around it
8 units of waste: the furnace is on the verge of melting down, everything around it is ablaze
10 units of waste: nuclear power, light and easy— uh oh, uh oh!
alexscaves_nuclear_convergence.ponder.ma: A Magnetic Quarry needs 4 Magnetic Lights to mark its mining area
The rectangle between the lights is the mining area, up to 20 blocks
With all four corners set, place a smasher in the center of the area
The smasher flies around the area and breaks the blocks below
The resources it breaks are pulled back to the quarry
When there is nothing left to mine, the quarry stops
alexscaves_nuclear_convergence.ponder.su: Start with a 3×3 layer of copper blocks
Build the second and third levels from copper blocks and the Enigmatic Engine like this, leaving the front row open
Fill the open row with Depth Glass
Once the hull is complete, the submarine assembles itself in place
Right-click to ride, WASD to drive and steer, Space / Ctrl to ascend or descend
